verification.ground_truth_source: Each of the 3 active NFTs is run through `vm.prank(holder)` + `NPM.decreaseLiquidity(fullLiquidity)` + `NPM.collect(uint128.max)` against the same forked Alchemy archive at block 25,151,872. The collect-return amounts are the canonical Uniswap V3 settlement: principal at current price + accrued fees + settled tokensOwed. The adapter's `getOracleBalanceForAsset(holder, token)` MUST equal that amount.
notes: This is the forked-EVM equivalent of a Tenderly `decreaseLiquidity + collect` simulation — same NPM contract, same archive state, same EVM. No derivation drift possible between adapter math and protocol settlement math.

The 18 strict-equality tests pin the adapter's outputs as regression baselines (catches future drift). The 3 ground-truth tests independently validate those baselines against the protocol itself (catches initial adapter-math bugs).
Branch coverage in one block: in-range + above-range + below-range principal/fees + settled tokensOwed > 0 (both tokens) + foreign-pool + closed-position filters + bounded iteration at 33 NFTs.
Math libs are bit-equivalent to Uniswap v3-periphery PositionValue per docs/decisions/0008-uniswap-v3-math-libs-gpl-license.md.
